product.olivetti-m4-64.summary: The 33 MHz DX M4 in the 305 Box chassis.
product.olivetti-m4-64.history: The M4 Modulo range targeted professionals and sat between the personal-use PCS and the higher-performance M6 Suprema. The guide identifies T.1 boards made in Singapore and Scarmagno.
product.olivetti-m4-64.warning: Partial BA2077 emulation using the compatible R2.03 A4BF BIOS.
product.olivetti-m4-64.architecture: The German brochure offered the M4-64 with 4 MB of RAM, 512 KB of video memory and 85/170/240 MB IDE disks. The guide documents T.1 and T.1.5 revisions, including the BA2077 shared with the other Modulo models in this series. OverDrive was an upgrade.
product.olivetti-m4-64.verified: BluMach tested POST and floppy boot with the factory processor, 4 MB of RAM and onboard VGA. It also checked VGA mode 13h and video memory.
product.olivetti-m4-64.limitations: POST displays “RUN SETUP”. Olivetti Setup and the retail IDE disks still need testing. Emulation uses compatible models for the 83C206Q and the keyboard controller.
product.olivetti-m4-64.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 2
product.olivetti-m4-64.firmware: The preserved M4-65 R2.03 A4BF BIOS boots this BA2077 configuration. The guide documents 2.06 PDK0 as the last service revision. This model’s factory BIOS remains unconfirmed.
product.olivetti-m4-64.source-brochure: Olivetti GmbH, M4-60/62/64/65/66 Modulo · Drucknummer 12129 · p. 2
product.olivetti-m4-64.creation.note: Place the compatible 128 KiB M4-65 ROM at roms/machines/olivetti_m4_65/R2_03_A4BF.BIN.
product.olivetti-m4-64.source-bios: TiBo, Internet Archive, Olivetti M4-65 R2.03 A4BF, 18 September 2023: dump and photographs of the EPROM and BA2077 board. Physical provenance not independently verified; unknown rights.
The brochure disks still require their original geometries and the Olivetti Setup workflow. Mount a bootable floppy to get started.
product.olivetti-m4-64.creation.offer: 305 BOX · RAM 4 MB · VGA 512 KB · IDE 85/170/240 MB
